_doc: Worker model by PROFILE (tier). Reads are 95-99% of a worker's tokens, so the cache-READ rate is the price. Resolution: explicit model > this list > settings.crew.defaultModel. A profile may appear in ONE tier. Adding/moving a profile is a reviewed diff.

cross_family_review.why: main is one model family; an independent reviewer must not share its blind spots — pick the strongest model from another family you have access to.

build.why: the implementer's mistakes are the expensive ones (a wrong PR costs a review round); strongest Claude per read-dollar.

read_and_record.why: reads, summarizes, polls, keeps the record; main judges the output. Sonnet-5 is the cheapest Claude on every rate column.
